RB-318  auth-gateway: 5xx rate above 3% (SEV-2)
Owner: identity-platform. Last reviewed: 2026-10-02.

This is user-facing: logins fail while the alert is active. Open a SEV-2 incident before you start and post updates every 15 minutes.

1. read_logs auth-gateway and group the errors by upstream (session-store, user-directory).
2. http_request GET http://auth-gateway.internal:8080/healthz and record the response.
3. If the errors point at session-store timeouts, get_config auth-gateway and check request_timeout_s (expected: 5).
4. restart_service auth-gateway one pod at a time; never restart all replicas together.
5. Confirm the 5xx rate stays below 0.5% for ten minutes, then downgrade the incident.

CHG-5458  Enable feature_flags.eta_predictions on shipment-tracker
Owner: logistics-integrations (Halvard Logistics). Product sign-off is attached to the change. Rollback: set the flag to false.

1. get_config shipment-tracker and confirm feature_flags.eta_predictions is false and the model endpoint is set.
2. http_request GET http://eta-model.internal/healthz and confirm a 200 response.
3. update_config shipment-tracker feature_flags.eta_predictions=true.
4. read_logs shipment-tracker for 15 minutes and look for 'eta_model_error'.
5. Open three tracked parcels in the internal tracking view and check that each one shows an ETA.
6. Update CHG-5458 with the result and close it.
